title: Bubbles, re-shot on a pan heated from the bottom
question: Which of these four should be the default for boiling water? Animated this time, and on a pan heated from below the way you asked. Named rather than blind, so your comment maps back to what you were looking at.
context_md:
Two things were wrong with the card you saw and both were mine.

**I shot it on the wrong scene.** You said: *"if we are testing bubbles in water the boiling needs to happen at the bottom of the pond/lake instead of the top."* Exactly right, and there was already a scene for it -- `simmer`, a shallow pan over a hot hearth, whose own comment in the code is that complaint written down in advance. I used the surface-heated one instead, which is the one scene where three of the four modes cannot differ.

**And I used stills for a motion question.** These are GIFs. 90 frames of a pan at a rolling simmer, 5x zoom.

**One of the four was also broken, and your card is what found it.** SURFACE needed a cell to be both near the top of the water *and* hot itself -- and heat comes from underneath, so on any bottom-heated pool those are never the same cell and the mode drew essentially nothing: **25 changed pixels out of 97,460**. It now reads the heat in the water *below* a surface cell, which is where the bubble came from. Same measurement now: **1,650**.

Pixels differing from OFF on this pan, so you can see how much each one is actually doing:

| | changed pixels |
|---|---|
| RISING | 3,250 (3.3%) |
| SURFACE | 1,650 (1.7%) |
| COLUMNS | 1,350 (1.4%) |

None of them costs anything measurable: a forced full-screen redraw of this scene is 9.37 ms with bubbles off and 9.25 ms with SURFACE on, against a run-to-run spread of 9.25-12.50.

The pan holds **166 cells warm enough to bubble** at the moment these start, so if one of them looks empty that is the mode, not the scene.

items.label: OFF (current)
items.caption: Heat glow only. Boiling reads as the steam above the pan.

items.label: RISING
items.caption: Domed highlights scrolling up, scattered through the whole depth

items.label: COLUMNS
items.caption: Same but stretched into short streams, climbing twice as fast

items.label: SURFACE
items.caption: Only near the top, lit by how hot the water underneath it is
